summary: Iteration 5 — Verified (1) Multi-item Cart and (2) Seller Order Badge. Backend: 15/15 new tests pass (test_cart_and_pending.py) covering pending-count (seller-only, drops on accept/reject/cancel, 0 for buyer/third-party), multi-item orders (per-line subtotals & total correct for 3-product order 10k*2 + 15k*1 + 25k*3 = 110k), cross-merchant item -> 400, duplicate pid -> 400, >20 items -> 422, empty items -> 422. Regression test_orders_and_feed_scope.py 34/34 pass. Frontend (mobile 390x844): buyer login -> /app/marketplace -> ProductDialog qty-plus -> order-add-to-cart -> toast, dialog closes, cart-bar appears with cart-count/cart-bar-total; add 2nd product then merge same product (qty accumulates); cart-sheet with cart-item-<pid>, cart-plus/minus adjust cart-qty-<pid> and cart-total; minus-at-1 removes item; cart-note-input + cart-submit navigates to /app/pesanan; cart-bar disappears; order persisted via API (items/qty/total verified). Cart persists across reload. cart-clear empties. Other-shop warning (cart-other-shop-warning) shown when adding from a different merchant; adding replaces cart. 'Pesan Sekarang' (order-submit-button) still works for single-item direct order. Own product shows product-own-note and hides both cart & direct-order buttons. Seller sees marketplace-order-badge on bottom-nav Marketplace tab after buyer submits (polling picks it up within <10s) and marketplace-orders-badge on 'Pesanan' header; after accept, both badges disappear once poll fires. Buyer sees no badges. Cart is user-scoped: another user in same browser doesn't see cart after logout/login.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile 390x844 the bottom action row (cart-clear/cart-submit) can sit just outside the viewport in some viewports; Playwright reported 'Element is outside of the viewport' for cart-clear. Visually the sheet still allows clicking because of the mobile overlay, but the sheet content isn't scrollable to reach them cleanly. Consider wrapping the SheetContent in a scroll container or giving the footer a sticky-bottom position.

action_items: LOW: make CartBar SheetContent footer sticky-bottom so cart-clear/cart-submit are never clipped on short viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/orders.py: pending-count is a clean count_documents on {seller_id, status:PENDING} — correct and scoped to seller side only. ✅
orders.py create_order: lines[] built from DB-fetched product price/name; total = sum(subtotal); duplicate pid, cross-merchant, unavailable, own-shop all raise 400. ✅

cart.js: per-user key sz_cart_<uid>, dispatches storage event; `add` auto-replaces when merchant_id differs (new base ignores prior cart) — matches 'replace cart' requirement; MAX_CART_ITEMS=20 cap exactly matches backend Field(max_length=20). ✅
ProductDialog.jsx: cart-other-shop-warning renders when otherShop true; addCart doesn't block (replace semantics). ✅
CitizenLayout.jsx: polls /orders/pending-count on 8s interval + on route change; graceful 0 on error. ✅
LOW: CartBar sheet footer (cart-clear/cart-submit row) can clip on short viewports; add sticky bottom or ensure flex layout pushes it inside viewport.

LOW: cart `setQty` is called without a prior merchant guard — if cart is null (e.g., cleared between renders), it will crash on `cart.items`. Current call sites always check `cart` via useCart's state at component mount, so not reproducible in practice, but defensive null check in setQty would be safer.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of listed acceptance criteria (cart flow, persistence, isolation, other-shop warning, direct order, own-product note, seller badge bottom-nav + header, badge disappears post-accept, buyer no badge)
